name: B-52H Stratofortress
note: USAF subsonic strategic heavy bomber, in service since 1961 and planned to ~2050. Carries up to 20 air-launched cruise missiles plus a wide mix of bombs and missiles (70,000 lb). Unrefuelled combat range over 8,800 miles; combat radius here is an estimate.

name: H-6K
note: PLAAF Xi'an H-6K ('God of War'), a heavily modernised Tu-16 derivative and China's primary strategic bomber.
